tile_grid_recommendation.title: WHAT DO YOU WANT TO DO?

duplicates_resolution.broadcast: Kept as tile action and inside Campaigns section; removed secondary standalone duplicate inside My Brand menu.
duplicates_resolution.inventory: Kept as top tile action for quick access and inside Manage section for full lot browsing.
duplicates_resolution.calendar: Consolidated under Manage for daily activity scheduling; removed duplicate calendar entry from personal Settings.
duplicates_resolution.call_retries: Moved to new Leads section as core rep setting; removed duplicate from Settings.
duplicates_resolution.leaderboard: Personal rep position stays in My Performance; cross-account organization ranking stays in Admin > Account Management.
duplicates_resolution.imos_demo_leads: Lead Attribution and Hot Leads remain strictly in Admin > Account Management under title 'iMOS Website Leads' to avoid confusion with dealership sales leads.

visual_and_ui_guidance.leads_section_styling: Uses flame red (#FF3B30) icon background and badge border. Default expanded on Hub load for immediate visibility.
visual_and_ui_guidance.badge_treatment: Red numeric badge pill (#FF3B30) for waiting leads count on Internet Leads row and Leads section header pill.
visual_and_ui_guidance.admin_grouping: Admin sections remain visually distinct with dark translucent background, muted text label headers, and shield-half red emblem.
visual_and_ui_guidance.type_scale_adherence: Strictly adheres to 28 header, 20 title, 17 nav, 16 row title, 15 body, 13 secondary, 12 eyebrow, 11 badge scale.

changes: Add 'leads' section object with Internet Leads, Call Retries, Lead Source Queue, Lead Source Config, and Team Availability.
Remove Lead Source Queue, Lead Source Config, and Team Availability from 'setup_manage' section.
Update taskGrid array to feature 'Internet Leads' as the top-left primary action tile.

GENERAL UI UX DESIGN GUIDELINES.data_testid_rule: All interactive buttons, headers, tiles, and input elements must include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case format.
GENERAL UI UX DESIGN GUIDELINES.no_transparent_overlays: Never use completely transparent backgrounds for dropdowns, headers, or overlays.
GENERAL UI UX DESIGN GUIDELINES.micro_interactions: Ensure proper activeOpacity, touch feedback, and smooth LayoutAnimation transitions for section toggles.
